children: INNSUITES HOSPITALITY TRUST reported results for the second quarter ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $1.84M, a consolidated net loss of $297K and diluted EPS of $(0.02), reflecting modest top-line growth and an improved loss versus the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: $1.84M for Q2 FY2027 (three months ended Jul 31, 2026), up from $1.80M in the year-ago quarter (2.1% YoY).
Net income: Consolidated net loss $297K for Q2 FY2027 vs. net loss $401K in the year-ago quarter (improvement of $104K, (26%) YoY).
Diluted EPS: $(0.02) for Q2 FY2027 vs. $(0.04) in the year-ago quarter (improved loss per share YoY).
Room revenue momentum: Room revenues rose modestly — up 1% year-to-date and 3% in the quarter — driven by higher occupancy despite slight declines in ADR.
Occupancy & RevPAR: Combined occupancy increased to 83.4% year-to-date with RevPAR improving about 2%, aided by stronger demand following major refurbishments.
Brand and channel development: Continued Best Western branding for both hotels and expanded InnSuites/IBC management and reservations capabilities.
Operational improvements: Major refurbishments completed at Tucson and Albuquerque reduced maintenance spending and enhanced guest amenities.
Diversification: Management is pursuing growth through a UniGen clean-energy investment and an IBC boutique reservations strategy.
